jobs.title: Accessibility
jobs.description: FirstPoint – Accessibility Statement Platform FPLock Company Careers Contact Accessibility Statement Accessibility Statement FirstPoint Mobile Guard (“ we “) are committed to providing a website that is accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of circumstance and ability. We make every effort and invest many resources to provide all our clients with equal, fair, dignified, accessible, efficient and professional services, in accordance with the Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law, 5758-1998, and its regulations. To achieve this, the website adheres to the Israeli Standard (IS 5568) for the Accessibility of Internet Content at AA Level and to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1, Level AA), published by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C). Accessibility Measures This website utilizes an AI-based accessibility widget provided by accessiBe. This software is designed to assist in improving its compliance with the accessibility of the website based on the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1). The accessibility menu can be triggered by clicking the accessibility menu icon that appears on the corner of the page. After triggering the accessibility menu, please wait a moment for the accessibility menu to load in its entirety. Through this interface, users can customize the website to their needs, including: Screen Reader Optimization: For blind users using screen readers (e.g., JAWS, NVDA). Keyboard Navigation: Enabling navigation via the Tab, Shift+Tab, and Enter keys. Visual Adjustments: modifying contrast, font size, spacing, and color profiles. Cognitive Support: Stopping animations and highlighting essential content. Technical Specifications Accessibility of the FirstPoint Mobile Guard website relies on the following technologies to work with the particular combination of web browser and any assistive technologies or plugins installed on your computer: HTML WAI-ARIA CSS JavaScript Compatibility Our website is tested and optimized for compatibility with the following assistive technologies: Google Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Microsoft Edge. Screen readers including JAWS and NVDA. Physical Accessibility FirstPoint Mobile Guard Headquarters Address: 4 Dolev ST, Raanana, Israel Parking: There are marked disabled parking spots available on Dolev Street. Entrance: The building entrance is wheelchair accessible via a level pathway Restrooms: Accessible restrooms are located on the 1st floor. Service Animals: Service animals are welcome. Feedback and Contact Information Despite our best efforts to allow anyone to adjust the website to their needs, there may still be pages or sections that are not fully accessible, are in the process of becoming accessible, or lack an adequate technological solution to make them accessible. We are continually improving our accessibility options. If you encounter any difficulty accessing any part of this website, or if you need assistance with any part of our site, please contact our accessibility coordinator, who will be happy to help: Name: Dubi Lavi Telephone:972-50-6299611 Email: dubi@firstpoint-mg.com . This statement was last updated on: 25 January 2026 Stay connected with FirstPoint. Your complete solution for secure connectivity.
